newsitem.title: UK: Short covering boosts UK grain futures.
newsitem.headline: Short covering boosts UK grain futures.

text.p: Short covering ahead of the weekend boosted UK grain futures on an otherwise quiet market on Friday.
"There were a few shorts about and that's all there is to it today," said a trader.
Wheat futures closed 0.60 to 0.20 stg up after trading 276 lots while barley was 0.30 to 0.25 stg higher on a turnover of 125 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures closed one to two marks higher after trading 21 lots.
UK fob prices were around 0.50 stg higher but sellers found little buying interest on a quiet market.
Delivered trade was also slow with traders reporting no significant business.
